metadata.ogTitle: GatoPouch — The cat-wearing hoodie for hands-free cuddles
metadata.ogDescription: Fleece hoodie with a front pouch for wearing your cat against you. From 54.99€, Pack of 2 recommended 94.98€, free shipping from 69€.

hero.subtitle: The GatoPouch is the fleece hoodie with a front pouch for your cat. Keep them close to you, hands-free, at home or on the go. Shared happiness, on the move.

benefits.intro: The GatoPouch was designed with feline behaviorists and textile designers. Every detail is crafted to meet a need: to bring your cat closer to you, safely, in any situation.

items.title: Hands-Free Cuddles
items.desc: Carry your cat snuggled against your heart, wherever you go. Without using your arms, enjoy continuous cuddles, at the office or on a walk.

items.title: Premium Polar Fleece Comfort
items.desc: Thick sherpa fabric (300g/m²), ultra-soft and very warm. You and your cat stay warm even on freezing winter days or with strong air conditioning.

items.title: Reassuring Security
items.desc: The elasticated circular opening keeps your cat securely in place without constriction. The sliding cord adjusts the opening size to fit their body shape.

items.title: The Perfect WFH Buddy
items.desc: Your cat snuggled against you while you work. No more cats walking on the keyboard: they purr away in their pocket, calm and present.

items.title: Machine Washable
items.desc: Durable material, machine washable at 30°C. No shrinkage, no pilling. The fleece stays soft wash after wash.

items.title: The Perfect Gift
items.desc: Careful and premium packaging. Ideal for Christmas, Mother's Day, a birthday, or to surprise a fellow cat lover. The gift that tugs at the heartstrings.

steps.title: Put on the GatoPouch
steps.desc: Just like a classic hoodie. The thick fleece wraps you in softness. Adjust the hood as you like with the drawstrings.

steps.title: Invite your cat
steps.desc: Through the front pocket. The large circular elastic opening makes it easy for them to enter. Your cat slips in naturally, drawn to your warmth.

steps.title: Adjust the drawstring
steps.desc: Under the pocket, pull the sliding drawstring to adjust the opening size for your cat. They are held comfortably, with no pressure.

steps.title: Savor the moment
steps.desc: Hands-free! Work, walk, read, have a coffee. Your cat is purring against you, present and calm. Pure happiness.

productShowcase.intro: Every detail of the GatoPouch has been selected for the comfort of your cat and yours. From the thick fleece to the secure elasticated opening, everything is designed for hours of stress-free cuddles.

features.name: Thick 300g/m² sherpa fleece
features.desc: Ultra-soft, warm, and breathable fabric. Cocooning comfort for you and your cat.

features.name: Reinforced belly pouch
features.desc: Circular elasticated opening for comfort and security. Supports the cat without compressing them.

features.name: Adjustable drawstring cord
features.desc: Under the pouch, adjust the opening size to your cat's body shape.

features.name: Side zippered pockets
features.desc: For keys, phone, treats. Everything you need, right at your fingertips.

features.name: Premium adjustable hood
features.desc: Cords with metal tips. Adjust to your head circumference. A quality detail.

features.name: Signature leather patch
features.desc: Faux leather label sewn on the bottom left. The detail that makes all the difference.

items.q: My cat doesn't like being carried, will it get used to it?
items.a: The vast majority of cats get used to it in 2 to 5 short sessions (5 minutes at first). The trick: place a treat in the pocket and let them explore at their own pace. The elastic opening doesn't constrict them, they feel secure. 92% of our customers report that their cat asks for the GatoPouch after a week!

The GatoPouch comes in 5 sizes: S, M, L, XL, 2XL, 3XL. To choose, take your usual chest measurement. If you're between two sizes, choose the larger one for more comfort and freedom of movement for your cat. A detailed size guide is sent after ordering.

items.q: Suitable for all cats, what weight?
items.a: The GatoPouch is suitable for cats from 2.5 kg to 7 kg. The reinforced pocket and elastic have been tested to support up to 8 kg without deformation. For cats over 7 kg (Maine Coon), we recommend the XL or XXL size and shorter sessions (the weight can be uncomfortable).

Yes! The GatoPouch is machine washable at 30°C on a gentle cycle, maximum spin 600 rpm. No tumble dryer (the sherpa can pill). Dry flat in the open air. The fleece stays soft, its color and shape wash after wash. Recommended once a week.

Absolutely not, as long as you respect the maximum weight (7-8 kg) and listen to your cat. The elastic opening never tightens, the drawstring cord is only used to adjust the entry size. Never force a reluctant cat. We recommend always supervising and keeping initial sessions to a maximum of 30 minutes.

Your GatoPouch is shipped within 24 business hours from our warehouse. Then allow 6 to 12 days for delivery (depending on your country and the period). A tracking number is sent to you by email upon shipment. Delivery is free on orders of €69 or more — automatically reached with the Pack of 2 at €94.98 (so the packs are always delivered for free!).

items.q: What material? Is it really warm?
items.a: The GatoPouch is made of thick 300g/m² sherpa fleece, ultra-soft and very warm. Ideal for autumn, winter, cool spring, and air-conditioned offices. The fabric is breathable: neither you nor your cat will overheat. The sherpa is durable and resistant to claw snags (with a moderate tap, your cat will quickly learn).

Yes! 3x interest-free payment is available on orders of €60 or more. The Pack of 2 at €94.98 can be paid in 3x of €31.66, and the Pack of 3 at €129.99 in 3x of €43.33. Ideal for gifting without the full upfront cost. We accept CB, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay via a secure SSL connection. Your banking details are never stored.

Conforme a la legislación de la UE, todos nuestros productos están garantizados 2 años contra defectos de fabricación. Si detectas un defecto, escríbenos con fotos a support@gatopouch.com y te enviaremos un reemplazo gratuito o un reembolso completo.

blocks.content: We ship to the entire European Union (Spain, France, Portugal, Italy, Germany, Belgium, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Austria, Ireland, etc.) as well as to the United Kingdom and Switzerland. For other destinations, please write to support@gatopouch.com.

You will receive an email with your tracking number at the time of shipment. You can track your package on the carrier's website (usually DHL or Correos). If you do not receive your package within a maximum of 12 days, please contact us and we will open an investigation with the carrier (resolved in 5-7 days).

If the carrier cannot deliver (absence, wrong address), the package will be returned to our warehouse in Málaga. We will contact you by email to arrange a reshipment (with additional costs) or a refund (without shipping costs).

For shipments outside the EU (United Kingdom, Switzerland), the recipient is responsible for customs duties and local taxes. GatoPouch does not cover these costs. For orders within the EU, there are no customs or additional taxes.

All our orders are shipped in recyclable and discreet packaging (no mention of the content on the outside, ideal for gifts). The Pack of 2 and Pack of 3 can be sent to different addresses upon request (please write to us after placing your order).
